title: Array copy with source and destination offsets
summary: Executes raw-word copy loops with optional local-valued source and destination offsets, preserving all store fields and bytes outside the copied interval.
premises: Exact equality with the emitted copy region
An empty operand stack and getters for source, target, count, and any offset locals
A valid counter local distinct from every read local
Source-offset plus count and destination-offset plus count lie inside their respective word ranges
Complete source and destination arrays fit current memory and the 32-bit address range
Complete source and destination regions are disjoint
A continuation consuming copied-word equality, WritesRange, and the final counter frame
result: The loop terminates after count writes and copies source[offset+i] to destination[offset+i], with independently chosen offsets. It preserves the complete store outside the destination write interval.
